exercises.q: What does до- add in добавля́ть (“to add”)?
options: adding to what there was before
completing an action, reaching a goal
fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists добавля́ть under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).

exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists доба́вить under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).

exercises.q: What does при- add in приписа́ть (“to add (by writing)”)?
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists приписа́ть under this meaning of при-. Source: Wiktionary, «при-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/при-#Russian).

exercises.q: Tom took credit for my idea.
exercises.why: **приписал** — приписа́ть (perfective): to add (by writing); to attach, to register; to arrogate, to ascribe, to attribute, to impute. Wiktionary: при- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: He took credit for my accomplishments.
exercises.why: **приписал** — приписа́ть (perfective): to add (by writing); to attach, to register; to arrogate, to ascribe, to attribute, to impute. Wiktionary: при- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
